notes.title: Let's go! ♣️ Queen of Clubs

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/e2ea0525401c2f4d8fa5ff281793af12f2e90f41.png"]

In Queen of Clubs, you will be accompanying Faun Princess in her business venture, trying to make YOUR "Faun's Tavern" the key to reach the Kingdom's royal family!

Animated, talking portraits and 18+ scenes 🥵

A free demo is already available, and we're releasing Early Access builds regularly on our crowdfunding platforms, while polling and testing new ideas with the community!

We'll work HARD to come to Steam too as soon as possible!

notes.title: Princess & Conquest 2025/06 Update!
notes.content:
😎 Much has changed! Much has been fixed! Let's take a look.

First of all, NG Candies! This new currency not only will reward the player for reaching our many endings, but will also make the subsequent playthrough fresh again, by getting unique rewards for it!

The Cheat menu, now renamed Rewards menu (accessible with the Q key or in the pause menu), includes Cheats (unlockable with our Patreon code OR with NG Candies), Minigame Codes (to get special costumes by completing the challenges of our secondary projects), and the NG Candies Trading portal!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/9c990b1e873a8a77bcb0059dd87102d24e816c40.png"]

That's only the first part of this update! I've taken care of other issues you've pointed out lately! 

The Traveling NPCs (Amelie and her elusive friends) used to move around the Kingdom only if the player spent time in the overworld, but that's changed! Skipping hours by resting in Inns or at the Campsite will also allow them to move, following their needs and desires as before. It all feels natural 👌

You also get a pretty accurate Weather Forecast, scripted to be wrong on some occasions, provided you check with the cute paper boy in Clocktown during the morning!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/0f5e41f1510c8b2ecf2c3f7e09fcd60e3e35d98c.png"]
And finally
khheeheheheheiehiehehehehehehehehe, the first event for Toy Princess and her Toy Park appear in Beta! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/d8a3e3c54c0ce0865459d757fcb2a598ae905432.png"]

This means we're now constantly working to have it completed and delivered to Steam as soon as possible, while we keep working on it and proceed to smite every bug we encounter along the way! She's going to be great, we all love her already, time for some chaos in the Kingdom!

notes.title: Princess & Conquest 2025/01 Update!
notes.content:
The year has just begun, but I plan to go non-stop for a while! Here are 3 new Knights and some important gameplay changes for every Knight out there!

Rabi Knight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/67bd6b955bbaa614ab33d5a359d0e1d4c8c5def8.png
Magiknight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/9cee6b684420673d70a518d844c88f5bb76c99db.png
Clockwork Knight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/8caa2655a9d21564fb6369c9e362b65b505f184f.png

The Complete Weather rework 🌞☔ is pretty cool too, as I've reworked how daily weather works in Princess & Conquest. Before, it was pretty much randomized every time you left a building, or entered the Kingdom Map; now a daily forecast is calculated at the beginning of the day, and the weather changes accordingly during the day!

notes.title: Princess & Conquest Knight(s) Update! ⚔🛡
notes.content:
Huge update, cost me weeks of hard work and testing, but changes any playthrough by changing what we've considered untouchable until now: the Knight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/663817ae04606272692822abe6e1e7be6ee6d7b8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/f14aa751aa24907b31fe872da392b99617829333.png

Any of the 27 Knights adds small or big changes to how the player and the Kingdom interact with each other, opening more role-playing occasions and allowing us to push a little bit harder with unique playstyles!
And that's just the half of this update!
 
We've added Racial Potions and their Recipes that can only be obtained by defeating troops in field and siege battles! They all have unique purposes and are costly to conjure, but all of them are (bottled) ways to make your playthrough unique!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/35ffbbadc6c3c47ed1eb87dd977181e61c86cfac.png

notes.title: Early Access is da poop! NO MORE!
notes.content:
Time for an important announcement!

We've reached a point in development where I don't feel like it's right we're both held down and shielded by the "Early Access" label. 
The game already has an unprecedented amount of content, with 200+ animations and hundreds of scenes to meet, fuck, and ultimately get to know intimately the many characters populating the Kingdom, that's why...

ːcrownprincessː Princess & Conquest leaves Early Access in Mid-April! ːcrownprincessː

The development will continue after that point as free updates until we have delivered all we've promised, with 20 full Reigns and 20 main characters with at least 1 Route each! No loose end will be tolerated!

Until the day we release, I'll suspend any content addition and focus on bugs alone, so... report to me everything you find! To do so with ease, join our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/princessconquest (let's reach 10k members! ːstardogː)

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/d566fadafd4c37c55a2bbf165078cec8edadce29.png

Day 1 is over! And we have already been approved for trading cards! We know a lot of steam users care deeply about these so we will be taking care of them promptly. 

Thanks to a very... very  active community already here on Steam, we have a new update ready to roll out to fix some of the current issues some are struggling with! Thanks for being patient with us. As some of you have discovered P&C is a rather LARGE experience. And Large experiences means a lot of work.

We'll be putting more focus on fixing bugs and optimization for a bit.


Update Size: 700MB

Bug Fixes:

Changes:


 War Declarations possibly locking out the Player from accessing the Campsite at night

 NG+ correctly resetting Quests and acquired NSFW animations

 Tree Canopy passability issues

 Added "default" sprite calls for NPCs when the correct one can't be found

 Added a "missing resource" check that prevents the game from crashing when it doesn't find a picture/BGM/Sound Effect/Music Effect

 Increased the kickback of attacked enemies


Known Issues:


 Northern map has lag issues

 Issues with some controllers not syncing

 Current font makes it hard to use translators for those who don't speak English. (We are actively in plans to get a Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and Russian translations in the works. Please be patient.)

notes.title: Princess & Conquest is officially out on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/5818726933dc9090034cb30e8eced9f7d0ddcd14.png

It's finally time! Princess & Conquest has now officially made to Early Access on STEAM! We don't know how we fucking did it. But it's here! You can test it! You can play it!

And more importantly...

You can fap to it!!

Thank you to everyone who will be supporting us from now and into the future leading the the final release of this project. Being successful on steam will greatly impact not only the speed and content, but the quality of the game as time goes by. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/1aff54c7626c1ecbdf0934ea55080e8e8b4b1d28.png

Again big thanks to Towerfag for putting this products faith and trust into Critical Bliss and a thank you to steam for being fairly reasonable in regards to this title. We look forward to working with all of you in making P&C the best experience we can make.

P&C's first Early Access build on Steam is version v0.16.14!!

If you want to read more about this build's features make sure to check out TowerFag's website for details.

Build v0.16.14

See you guys real soon~
